<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary tensions:</strong> Congress leader Jairam Ramesh has alleged that the government may use an unprorogued Parliament session to push through Delimitation Bills, while the INDIA bloc’s &quot;mock Parliament&quot; protest against the Chief Election Commissioner drew sharp criticism from Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political setbacks:</strong> National Conference MP Aga Ruhullah has resigned from his Srinagar Lok Sabha seat, marking a significant challenge for the Omar Abdullah-led party.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi--?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial and legislative oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court is managing a busy agenda today, including a directive for the Centre to provide information regarding the whereabouts of an individual named Barman from Bangladesh.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
